neighbor_calibration.rule: threshold = max over training points of the distance to the nearest other training point, in standardized descriptor space

notes: Descriptors were standardized using training rows only.
Leverage h = x'(X'X)^-1 x is reported against the warning leverage h* = 3p/n; beyond it a prediction is an extrapolation.
Forward selection used BIC and rejected |r| > 0.95 descriptor pairs.
LOO, bootstrap, and permutation diagnostics keep the selected descriptor set fixed.
Group LOO holds out every row sharing the same ligand-group label.
A prospective claim still requires an experimentally untouched test set.

response.name: ddg_double_dagger
response.description: Transition-state free-energy difference between competing enantiomeric pathways.
response.sign_convention: ddG = G(S) - G(R); positive values favor the R product.
